description: This file defines the IDGeneratorService class responsible for generating unique IDs for various entity types in the OrangeHRM HRM system, such as Location, JobCategory, JobTitle, Membership, and Employee. It includes methods to retrieve and increment ID counters, with logic to prepend specific prefixes based on entity type.

classes.name: IDGeneratorService
classes.description: Service class for generating and managing unique IDs for various HRM entities, providing methods to retrieve next IDs with entity-specific prefixes.

methods.name: getIDGeneratorDao
methods.description: Returns the IDGeneratorDao instance, creating a new one if it does not exist.

methods.name: getEntityPrefix
methods.description: Returns the prefix string associated with the given entity class.

methods.name: getNextID
methods.description: Generates the next ID for a specified entity class, updating the counter if specified, and formats the ID with the entity's prefix and padding.

methods.name: incrementId
methods.description: Increments the ID counter for a given entity class.
